about_the_game:
You will transform into a party of adventurers with extraordinary skills, stepping into the mist-shrouded woodlands following the commotion from the depths of the forest. Those monsters that should have abided by the laws of nature have grown increasingly violent of late, frequently rushing out of their habitats to attack travelers. At this moment, you grip your weapons tightly and polish your staves, ready to explore the truth behind this abnormal riot in the shadowy depths tangled with vines!

Party Recruitment System: Recruit more adventurers at the tavern, and continuously level up and strengthen yourselves through battles to face more challenging fights.

Unit Chessboard: Each unit has its own attack logic. Through displacement and forced displacement, battles become easier to navigate.

Skill Awakening: All physical creatures have a chance to awaken skills after battles. Luck is also a form of strength.

Field Traps: The introduction of the field system makes positioning in battles more crucial. The shift between hunter and prey happens in an instant.
